vo_open.text: This shark's jaws shoot out of its face.

vo.text: When the goblin shark bites, its jaws fly forward, almost to the tip of its snout.
vo.cap: Its jaws fly forward, *almost to the snout.*

vo.text: Up to three point one four meters per second.
It's pink, because you can see the blood vessels under its skin.
vo.cap: Pink, from *blood vessels* under the skin.

vo.text: Its lineage is about a hundred twenty-five million years old. A living fossil.
In 2023, a pregnant female caught off Taiwan was four point seven meters long, and eight hundred kilos.
Would you swim with one? Yes or no? Comment below. Watch the full top seven, linked below. And subscribe.
